d092cad27748: A <t1>safety padlock</t1> is a personal safety lock belonging to a single worker, used in lockout–tagout (<t2>LOTO</t2>) procedures to keep an energy source shut off for the duration of maintenance. In the field it is also known as a LOTO lock or LOTO padlock. The worker fits their padlock onto a circuit breaker lockout device, valve lockout or lockout hasp; as long as the key stays in their pocket, no one else can re-energize that point.
